content:
# This is a Shiny web application. You can run the application by clicking
# the 'Run App' button above.

library(shiny)
library(fitODBOD)

# Explore exporting capabilities of table along with settings

##### UI ORGANIZATION #####

downloadButton <- function(...) {
  tag <- shiny::downloadButton(...)
  tag$attribs$download <- NULL
  tag
}

ui <- fluidPage(

    # Version info
    h5("Live Version 1.0.2, built 1/30/25"),
    ### Changelog
    ## Added NIST Software Disclaimer
    ## No Report Tab
    
    # Application title
    titlePanel("Lower Confidence Bounds for Seized Material Sampling"),
    
    # Input fields
    tabsetPanel(
      # Identification (hypergeometric) tab
      tabPanel("Identification", fluid=T,
    sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
          
          # Input panel for population size
          numericInput("seizureSize", "Population Size",
                       value=100, min=5, max=10000, step=1,
                       width="100%"),
          
          # Input panel for statistical significance level of the bounds
          numericInput("confidenceLevel", "Significance Level (alpha)",
                       value=0.05, min=0.0001, max=0.9999, step=0.0001,
                       width="100%"),
          
          hr(style = "border-top: 1px solid #000000;"),
          
          # Dropdown and subpanels for different avenues to choose the sample size
          selectInput("suppliedInfo", "Desired Minimum Proportion/Sample Size",
                      choices = c("Minimum Proportion", "Sample Size")),
          
          conditionalPanel(condition="input.suppliedInfo == 'Minimum Proportion'",
                           # re-examine "knowledge percentage labels"
                           # "targeted minimum proportion of seizure
                           numericInput("knowledgePercentage", "Targeted Minimum Proportion of Population",
                                        value=0.5, min=0, max=1, step=0.01,
                                        width="100%"),
                           numericInput("numError", "Negatives to Expect while Maintaining Minimum Proportion",
                                        value=0, min=0, max=100, step=1,
                                        width="100%"),
                           tags$div(title="Due to the discrete nature of the hypergeometric distribution, the minimum sample size sometimes decreases as seizure size increases. Checking this box ensures that minimum sample size only increases or stays the same as seizure size increases.",
                                    checkboxInput("monotonicCheck", "Monotonic?",
                                                  value=TRUE))),
          
          conditionalPanel(condition="input.suppliedInfo == 'Sample Size'",
                           numericInput("sampleSize", "Sample Size",
                                        value=5, min=1, max=100, step=1,
                                        width="100%")),
          
          hr(style = "border-top: 1px solid #000000;"),
          
          selectInput("falsePositiveModel", "False Positive Model",
                      choices = c("Binomial", "Correlated Binomial")),
          
            # Input panel for assumed false positive ID rate
            numericInput("falsePositiveRate", "False Positive Rate",
                         value=0, min=0, max=1, step=0.01,
                         width="100%"),
            
            # Input panel for assumed correlation among false positive IDs
            conditionalPanel(condition="input.falsePositiveModel == 'Correlated Binomial'",
                             numericInput("correlatedBinomialCorrelation", "Correlation",
                             value=0, min=-1, max=1, step=0.001,
                             width="100%")),
          
          # Dropdown and subpanels for different handlings of false positives
          selectInput("falsePositiveHandling", "False Positive Control",
                      choices = c("Adaptive", "Minimum Observed Positives", "None")),
          
            conditionalPanel(condition="input.falsePositiveHandling == 'Adaptive'",
                            numericInput("falseAllowed", "Maximum Error Probability for a Null Population",
                                        value=0.05, min=0, max=1, step=0.01,
                                        width="100%")),
            conditionalPanel(condition="input.falsePositiveHandling == 'Minimum Observed Positives'",
                             numericInput("negsAllowed", "Minimum Observed Positives for Statistical Reporting",
                                          value=2, min=0, max=5, step=1, width="100%")),
          
          hr(style = "border-top: 1px solid #000000;"),
          
          # Checkbox and subpanel for requesting random number generation for sampling
          checkboxInput("includerng", "Random Number Generation?", value=FALSE),
          
            conditionalPanel(condition="input.includerng",
                             numericInput("numPops", "Number of Populations",
                                          value=1, min=1, max=100, step=1, width="100%")),
          
          # Checkbox and subpanel for plotting error probabilities resulting from a supplied population distribution
          checkboxInput("includeErrorPlot", "Plot Error Probabilities?",
                        value=FALSE),
          
            conditionalPanel(condition="input.includeErrorPlot",
                             selectInput("hypoDistType", "Population Occurrence Selection Mode:",
                                         choices = c("Smooth Curve", "Table Specification")),
                             
                               conditionalPanel(condition="input.hypoDistType == 'Smooth Curve' & input.includeErrorPlot",
                                                sliderInput("beta.a", "First Shape Parameter",
                                                            value=1, min=0.2, max=2, step=0.01),
                                                sliderInput("beta.b", "Second Shape Parameter",
                                                            value=1, min=0.2, max=2, step=0.01)),
                               
                               conditionalPanel(condition="input.hypoDistType == 'Table Specification'",
                                                actionButton('addRowButton', 'Add Row'), br(),
                                                div(style="display: inline-block; width: 41%;",
                                                textInput('remainderLabel', 'Population Type',
                                                          value="All Others")),
                                                div(style="display: inline-block; width: 41%;",
                                                numericInput('remainderProb', "Probability",
                                                             value=1, min=0, max=1, step=0.01)),
                                                tags$div(id='placeholder')
                                                )
                            )
        ),

        # Output elements
        mainPanel(
          textOutput("recommendedSampleSize"),   
          verbatimTextOutput("rngSamples"),
          tableOutput("lowerBoundTable"),
          textOutput("falsePositiveCorrectionNotice"),
          plotOutput("errorRateBarPlot")
        )
    )
      ),
    tabPanel("Counting", fluid=T,
             sidebarLayout(
               sidebarPanel(
                 numericInput("countingConfidenceLevel", "Significance Level (alpha)",
                              value=0.05, min=0.0001, max=0.9999, step=0.0001),
                 selectInput("countingIntervalType", "Interval Type",
                             choices=c("Two-Sided", "One-Sided")),
                 selectInput("weightUnits", "Units",
                             choices=c("g", "mg", "kg")),
                 numericInput("grossWeight", "Gross Weight",
                              value=1000, min=0, max=100000, step=0.0001),
                 numericInput("grossWeightUncertainty", "Gross Weight Uncertainty",
                              value=1, min=0, max=100000, step=0.0001),
                 numericInput("grossWeightDegreesOfFreedom", "Gross Weight Degrees of Freedom",
                              value=25, min=0, max=100000, step=1),
                 numericInput("countingSampleSize", "Sample Size",
                              value=5, min=0, max=100000, step=1),
                 numericInput("countingSampleMean", "Sample Mean",
                              value=1, min=0, max=100000, step=0.0001),
                 numericInput("countingSampleStandardDeviation", "Sample Standard Deviation",
                              value=0.001, min=0, max=100000, step=0.0001),
                 checkboxInput("countingAchievedConfidence", 
                               "Plot Simulated Achieved Confidence?", value=FALSE),
                 conditionalPanel(condition="input.countingAchievedConfidence",
                   actionButton("resimulate", "Resimulate")
                 )
               ),
               mainPanel(
                 textOutput("countPointEstimate"),
                 textOutput("countRoundedIntervalEstimate"),
                 textOutput("countIntervalEstimate"),
                 textOutput("countStandardErrorAndDegreesOfFreedom"),
                 plotOutput("countConfidenceSimulation")
               )
             )
             ),
    #tabPanel("Net Weight", fluid=T),
    
    # tabPanel("Generate Report", fluid=T,
    #          sidebarLayout(
    #            sidebarPanel(
    #              textInput("caseid", "Case ID"),
    #              textInput("itemid", "Item ID"),
    #              textInput("analystid", "Analyst"),
    #              checkboxInput("reportCount", "Report Seizure Count Information?", value=FALSE),
    #              conditionalPanel(condition="input.reportCount"),
    #              checkboxInput("reportIdentity", "Report Sample Identification Information?", value=FALSE),
    #              conditionalPanel(condition="input.reportIdentity",
    #                               numericInput("reportIdentityPos", "Observed Positives", 
    #                                            value=NA, min=5, max=10000, step=1, width="100%")),
    #              #checkboxInput("reportWeight", "Report Net Weight Information?", value=FALSE),
    #              #conditionalPanel(condition="input.reportWeight"),
    #              # Button to print the state of the app to a file
    #              downloadButton("report", "Print Report")
    #            ),
    #            mainPanel()
    #          )),
    
    tabPanel("Disclaimer", fluid=T, mainPanel(htmlOutput("disclaimer")))
    )
    
    
)

##### SERVER LOGIC #####

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  ### IDENTIFICATION LOGIC ###
  # Extracting and validating numerical inputs
  seizureSize <- reactive({
    print('processing seizure size')
    validate(
      need(input$seizureSize, "Please input a seizure size."),
      need(input$seizureSize %% 1 == 0 & input$seizureSize > 0, "Please input a positive integer for population size.")
    )
    appSettings$populationSize <- input$seizureSize
    input$seizureSize
  })
  
  confidenceLevel <- reactive({
    print('processing significance level')
    validate(
      need(input$confidenceLevel, "Please input a significance level."),
      need(input$confidenceLevel < 1 & input$confidenceLevel > 0, "Please input a significance level strictly between 0 and 1.")
    )
    appSettings$alpha <- input$confidenceLevel
    input$confidenceLevel
  })
  
  inputSampleSize <- reactive({
    print('processing input sample size')
    req(input$suppliedInfo == "Sample Size")
    validate(
      need(input$sampleSize, "Please input a sample size."),
      need(input$sampleSize <= seizureSize(), "Please input a sample size smaller than the population size."),
      need(input$sampleSize %% 1 == 0 & input$sampleSize >= 0, "Please input a non-negative integer for sample size.")
    )
    input$sampleSize
  })
  
  knowledgePercentage <- reactive({
    print('processing knowledge percentage')
    req(input$suppliedInfo == "Minimum Proportion")
    validate(
      need(input$knowledgePercentage, "Please input a minimum proportion."),
      need(input$knowledgePercentage >= 0 & input$knowledgePercentage <= 1, "Please input a minimum proportion between 0 and 1.")
    )
    input$knowledgePercentage
  })
  
  numError <- reactive({
    print('processing number of assumed negatives')
    req(input$suppliedInfo == "Minimum Proportion")
    validate(
      need(input$numError, "Please input a number of assumed negatives."),
      need(input$numError < seizureSize(), "Please input a number of assumed negatives smaller than the population size."),
      need(input$numError %% 1 == 0 & input$numError >= 0, "Please input a non-negative integer for number of assumed negatives.")
    )
    input$numError
  })
  
  falsePositiveRate <- reactive({
    print('processing false positive rate')
    if(input$falsePositiveHandling == "Adaptive" | input$includeErrorPlot)
    {
      validate(
        need(input$falsePositiveRate, "Please input a false positive rate."),
        need(input$falsePositiveRate >= 0 & input$falsePositiveRate <= 1, "Please input a false positive rate between 0 and 1."),
        #need(input$falsePositiveRate > 0 | input$falsePositiveModel != "Correlated Binomial", "Please input a false positive rate greater than 0 while using the Correlated Binomial model.")
      )
    }
    appSettings$falsePositiveRate <- input$falsePositiveRate
    input$falsePositiveRate
  })
  
  falseAllowed <- reactive({
    print('processing null seizure error rate')
    req(input$falsePositiveHandling == "Adaptive")
    validate(
      need(input$falseAllowed, "Please input a maximum null population error rate."),
      need(input$falseAllowed >= 0 & input$falseAllowed <= 1, "Please input a maximum null population error rate between 0 and 1.")
    )
    input$falseAllowed
  })
  
  negsAllowed <- reactive({
    print('processing minimum observed positives')
    req(input$falsePositiveHandling == "Minimum Observed Positives")
    validate(
      need(input$negsAllowed, "Please input a number of minimum observed positives."),
      need(input$negsAllowed <= sampleSize(), "Please input a number of minimum observed positives no larger than the sample size."),
      need(input$negsAllowed %% 1 == 0 & input$negsAllowed >= 0, "Please input a non-negative integer for number of minimum observed positives.")
    )
    input$negsAllowed
  })
  
  numPops <- reactive({
    print('processing number of generated random samples')
    req(input$includerng == TRUE)
    validate(
      need(input$numPops, "Please input a number of random sample selections."),
      need(input$numPops %% 1 == 0 & input$numPops > 0, "Please input a positive integer for number of random sample selections.")
    )
    input$numPops
  })

  correlatedBinomialCorrelation <- reactive({
    print('processing correlated binomial correlation')
    req(input$falsePositiveModel == "Correlated Binomial")
    lower.bound <- dCorrBinRobust(0, sampleSize(), falsePositiveRate(), 0)$mincorr
    upper.bound <- dCorrBinRobust(0, sampleSize(), falsePositiveRate(), 0)$maxcorr
    validate(
      need(input$correlatedBinomialCorrelation, "Please input a correlated binomial model correlation."),
      need(input$correlatedBinomialCorrelation >= lower.bound & input$correlatedBinomialCorrelation <= upper.bound, paste0("Please input a correlated binomial model correlation between ", lower.bound, " and ", upper.bound, "."))
    )
    input$correlatedBinomialCorrelation
  })
  
  manualPlotSupport <- reactive({
    print('processing pmf support')
    req(input$includeErrorPlot)
    req(input$hypoDistType == "Table Specification")
    req(length(probRows()) > 0)
    
    requiredInputLabels <- sapply(probRows(), function(l) paste0('truepos', l))
    req(prod(sapply(requiredInputLabels, function(l) sum(grepl(l, names(input))))) > 0)
    
    truepos.values <- vapply(requiredInputLabels, function(l) input[[l]], 0)
    validate(
      need(prod(!is.na(truepos.values)), "Please fill in the first column of the probability table."),
      need(prod(truepos.values %% 1 == 0) & prod(truepos.values >= 0) & prod(truepos.values <= seizureSize()), "Please fill in the first column of the probability table with integers between 0 and the seizure size."),
      need(length(truepos.values) == length(unique(truepos.values)), "Please don't repeat values in the first column of the probability table.")
    )
    truepos.values
  })
  
  manualPlotProbabilities <- reactive({
    print('processing pmf probabilities')
    req(input$includeErrorPlot)
    req(input$hypoDistType == "Table Specification")
    req(length(probRows()) > 0)
    
    requiredInputLabels <- sapply(probRows(), function(l) paste0('hypoprob', l))
    req(prod(sapply(requiredInputLabels, function(l) sum(grepl(l, names(input))))) > 0)
    
    hypoprob.values <- vapply(requiredInputLabels, function(l) input[[l]], 0)
    validate(
      need(prod(!is.na(hypoprob.values)), "Please fill in the second column of the probability table."),
      need(prod(hypoprob.values >=0) & prod(hypoprob.values <= 1), "Please fill in the second column of the probability table with values between 0 and 1."),
      need(sum(hypoprob.values) <= 1, "Please choose values for the second column of the probability table whose sum is at most 1.")
    )
    hypoprob.values
  })
  
  # Changing inputs according to bounds induced by other inputs.
  observeEvent(seizureSize(), {
    updateNumericInput(session, "sampleSize", max=seizureSize())
    updateNumericInput(session, "numError", max=seizureSize())
  }) 
  
  observeEvent(sampleSize(), {
    updateNumericInput(session, "negsAllowed", max=sampleSize())
    updateNumericInput(session, "reportIdentityPos", max=sampleSize())
  })
  
  observeEvent(manualPlotProbabilities(), {
    remainderProb <- (1-sum(manualPlotProbabilities()))/(seizureSize()+1-length(manualPlotSupport()))
    updateNumericInput(session, "remainderProb", value=round(remainderProb,4))
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$includeErrorPlot==F, {
    exportedObjects$errorPlot=NULL
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$includerng==F, {
    exportedObjects$randomSamples=NULL
  })
  
  
  
  # Reactive values object for exporting plots/tables to a report
  # Add app settings to the report output (confidence level, etc)
  exportedObjects <- reactiveValues(table=NULL,
                                    recommendedSampleSize=NULL,
                                    sampleSizeNum=NULL,
                                    tableFootnote=NULL,
                                    randomSamples=NULL,
                                    errorPlot=NULL)
  
  appSettings <- reactiveValues(populationSize=NULL,
                                alpha=NULL,
                                falsePositiveRate=NULL,
                                falsePositiveCorrection=NULL,
                                falsePositiveCorrectionParameter=NULL,
                                falsePositiveType=NULL,
                                falsePositiveCorrelationParameter=NULL,
                                targetedConclusion=NULL,
                                targetedValue=NULL,
                                expectedNegativesForMinimumProportion=NULL,
                                monotonicFlag=NULL)
  
  # Server logic for setting the false positive model functions
  falsePositiveModelFunctions <- reactive({
    out.functions <- list()
    appSettings$falsePositiveType = input$falsePositiveModel
    if(input$falsePositiveModel == "Binomial")
    {
      out.functions <- list(dmodel = function(x, size, prob){dbinom(x, size, prob)},
                            qmodel = function(x, size, prob){qbinom(x, size, prob)})
    }
    if(input$falsePositiveModel == "Correlated Binomial")
    {
      appSettings$falsePositiveCorrelationParameter = correlatedBinomialCorrelation()
      out.functions <- list(dmodel = function(x, size, prob, corr=correlatedBinomialCorrelation()){dCorrBinRobust(x, size, prob, corr*prob*(1-prob))$pdf},
                            qmodel = function(x, size, prob, corr=correlatedBinomialCorrelation()){qCorrBinRobust(x, size, prob, corr*prob*(1-prob))})
    }
    out.functions
  })
  
  # Server logic for calculating sample size based on inputs
  sampleSize <- reactive({
    
    appSettings$targetedConclusion <- input$suppliedInfo
    if(input$suppliedInfo=='Sample Size')
    {
      appSettings$targetedValue <- inputSampleSize()
      sampleSize = inputSampleSize()
    } 
    else 
    {
      appSettings$targetedValue <- knowledgePercentage()
      appSettings$expectedNegativesForMinimumProportion <- numError()
      appSettings$monotonicFlag <- input$monotonicCheck
      if(input$monotonicCheck)
      {
        sampleSize = minimum_knowledge_sample_size_monotonic(seizureSize(), numError(), knowledgePercentage(), confidenceLevel())
        #sampleSize = max(sapply(seizureSize():(seizureSize()-2), minimum_knowledge_sample_size, numError(), knowledgePercentage(), confidenceLevel()))
      }
      else
      {
        sampleSize = minimum_knowledge_sample_size(seizureSize(), numError(), knowledgePercentage(), confidenceLevel())
      }
    }
    exportedObjects$sampleSizeNum = sampleSize
    sampleSize
  })
  
  # Server logic for calculating lower confidence bounds based on inputs
  lcbs <- reactive({
    
    possible.positives <- sampleSize():0
    lcbs = olcb.hgps(possible.positives, sampleSize(), seizureSize(), confidenceLevel())
    
    no.stats <- sampleSize()+1
    appSettings$falsePositiveRate <- falsePositiveRate()
    appSettings$falsePositiveCorrection <- input$falsePositiveHandling
    if(input$falsePositiveHandling == 'Adaptive')
    {
      appSettings$falsePositiveCorrectionParameter <- falseAllowed()
      if(falsePositiveRate() > 0)
      {
        no.stats <- possible.positives[rev(possible.positives<=falsePositiveModelFunctions()$qmodel(1-falseAllowed(), sampleSize(), falsePositiveRate()))]+1
      }
    }
    if(input$falsePositiveHandling == 'Minimum Observed Positives')
    {
      appSettings$falsePositiveCorrectionParameter <- negsAllowed()
      
      if(negsAllowed() > 0)
      {
        negs.allowed <- sampleSize() - negsAllowed()
        no.stats <- (negs.allowed+2):(sampleSize()+1)
      }
    }
  
    #lcbs[no.stats] <- possible.positives[no.stats]
    lcbs[no.stats] <- 0
    lcbs.display <- lcbs
    if(length(no.stats) > 1)
    {
      no.stats.no.zero <- no.stats[no.stats != sampleSize()+1]
      lcbs.display[no.stats.no.zero] <- paste0(lcbs[no.stats.no.zero], '*')
    }
    
    list(values=lcbs, display=lcbs.display)
  })
  
    # Server logic for rendering calculated sample size
    output$recommendedSampleSize <- renderText({
      if(input$suppliedInfo == "Sample Size")
      {
        sampleSizeStr <- "Chosen Sample Size: "
      }
      if(input$suppliedInfo == "Minimum Proportion")
      {
        sampleSizeStr <- "Recommended Sample Size: "
      }
      if(sampleSize() == Inf){exportedObjects$recommendedSampleSize <- "Cannot guarantee requested knowledge percentage at this significance level and expected number of negative units in the sample even if all units are tested."}
      else{exportedObjects$recommendedSampleSize <- paste0(sampleSizeStr, sampleSize(), '.')}
      exportedObjects$recommendedSampleSize
    })
    
    # Server logic for rendering rng samples
    output$rngSamples <- renderText({
      sampleLabels <- lapply(1:numPops(), function(l) sample(1:seizureSize(), sampleSize()))
      exportedObjects$randomSamples <- sampleLabels
      if(numPops() == 1)
      {
        paste0("Units to sample: ", paste(sort(sampleLabels[[1]]), collapse=', '))
      }
      else
      {
        paste(sapply(1:numPops(), function(l) paste0("Population ", l, " units to sample: ", paste(sort(sampleLabels[[l]]), collapse=', '))), collapse="\n")
      }
    })
  
    # Server logic for rendering sampling table
    output$lowerBoundTable <- renderTable({
      
      if(sampleSize() == Inf)
      {
        exportedObjects$table <- data.frame(`Observed Positives`=NA,
                                            `Lower Confidence Bounds`=0,
                                            `Inferred Proportion`=0)
      }
      else
      {
        exportedObjects$table <- data.frame(`Observed Positives`=as.character(sampleSize():0),
                                            `Lower Confidence Bounds`=as.character(lcbs()$display),
                                            `Inferred Proportion`=as.character(round(lcbs()$values/seizureSize(),3)))
      }
      exportedObjects$table
    })
    
    # Server logic for rendering annotation of the sampling table when relevant
    output$falsePositiveCorrectionNotice <- renderText({
      
      render.false.positive.correction.notice <- F
      
      if(input$falsePositiveHandling == "Adaptive" & sampleSize() < Inf)
      {
        if(falsePositiveModelFunctions()$qmodel(1-falseAllowed(), sampleSize(), falsePositiveRate()) > 0)
        {
          render.false.positive.correction.notice <- T
        }
      }
      
      if(input$falsePositiveHandling == "Minimum Observed Positives")
      {
        if(negsAllowed() >1)
        {
          render.false.positive.correction.notice <- T
        }
      }
      
      if(render.false.positive.correction.notice)
      {
        exportedObjects$tableFootnote <- "Lower Confidence Bounds marked with an asterisk (*) have been adjusted to 0 in accordance with the selected false positive control scheme. While the observed number of positives should still be reported, no statistical statement should be included."
        exportedObjects$tableFootnote
      }
    })
    
    # Server logic for rendering error bar plot (if requested)
    output$errorRateBarPlot <- renderPlot({ if(input$includeErrorPlot == TRUE){
      
      prob.vector <- rep(1/(seizureSize()+1), seizureSize()+1)
      if(input$hypoDistType=='Smooth Curve')
      {
        relative <- dbeta(qbeta((1:(seizureSize()+1))/(seizureSize()+2), input$beta.a, input$beta.b), input$beta.a, input$beta.b)
        prob.vector <- relative/sum(relative)
      }
      else
      {
        prob.vector[manualPlotSupport()+1] = manualPlotProbabilities()
        prob.vector[-(manualPlotSupport()+1)] = (1-sum(manualPlotProbabilities()))/(seizureSize()-length(manualPlotSupport())+1)
      }
      
      errorRate <- error_rate_calc(seizureSize(), sampleSize(), rev(lcbs()$values), falsePositiveRate(), 0, falsePositiveModelFunctions()$dmodel)
      errorRateComposite <- round(1-sum(errorRate*prob.vector),5)
      
      if(errorRateComposite >= 1-confidenceLevel()){legendColor = "#DDFFDD"}
      else{legendColor = "#FFDDDD"}
      
      plotExportFunction <- function()
      {
        barplot(prob.vector, names.arg=0:seizureSize(), space=0,
                xlab=paste0("Number of Units Containing Targeted Substances in Populations of Size ", seizureSize()), ylab="Occurrence Frequency",
                main="Hypothetical Population Occurrence with Achieved Confidence",
                cex.main=0.7, cex.lab=0.7, cex.axis=0.7)
        legend(0.5*seizureSize(), max(prob.vector)*0.85,
               paste0("Achieved Confidence: ", errorRateComposite),
               box.col=legendColor, bg=legendColor, adj=0.05, cex=0.7)
      }
      
      exportedObjects$errorPlot <- plotExportFunction
      
      barplot(prob.vector, names.arg=0:seizureSize(), space=0,
              xlab=paste0("Number of Units Containing Targeted Substances in Populations of Size ", seizureSize()), ylab="Occurrence Frequency",
              main="Hypothetical Population Occurrence with Achieved Confidence")
      legend(0.5*seizureSize(), max(prob.vector)*0.85,
             paste0("Achieved Confidence: ", errorRateComposite),
             box.col=legendColor, bg=legendColor, adj=0.05)
      
      #barplot(errorRate, names.arg=0:input$seizureSize, space=0, 
      #        xlab="Number of True Positives", ylab="Error Probability", 
      #        main="Error Rates at each Number of True Positives")
      #lines(c(0,input$seizureSize), c(input$confidenceLevel,input$confidenceLevel), lty="dashed")
    }})
    
    # Server logic for handling the probability table option UI for the error probability barplot
    probRows <- reactiveVal()
    
    observeEvent(input$addRowButton, {
      
      btn <- input$addRowButton
      probRows(c(probRows(), btn))
      id.truepos <- paste0('truepos', btn)
      id.hypoprob <- paste0('hypoprob', btn)
      id.rmbut <- paste0('rmbut', btn)
      id.row <- paste0('row', btn)
      insertUI(
        selector = '#placeholder',
        ui = tags$div(
               fluidRow(
                 column(5, numericInput(id.truepos, label=NULL, value=NA, min=0, max=input$seizureSize, step=1)),
                 column(5, numericInput(id.hypoprob, label=NULL, value=0, min=0, max=1, step=0.01)),
                 column(2, actionButton(id.rmbut, "X"))
               ),
               id = id.row
             )
      )
      
      observeEvent(input[[id.rmbut]], {
        probRows(probRows()[probRows() != btn])
        removeUI(selector=paste0('#', id.row))
      })
    })
    
    
    
  ### COUNT LOGIC ###

# Auxiliary function for handling edge cases for correlated binomial
dCorrBinRobust <- function(x, size, prob, cov)
{
  if(size == 0 | prob == 0)
  {
    mass.function <- sapply(x, function(l) ifelse(l==0, 1, 0))
    return(list(pdf=mass.function,
                mean=0,
                var=0,
                corr=0,
                mincorr=0,
                maxcorr=0))
  }
  return(dCorrBin(x, size, prob, cov))
}

# Auxiliary function that implements the qbinom analogue for dCorrBin
qCorrBinRobust <- function(p, size, prob, cov)
{
  mass.function <- dCorrBinRobust(0:size, size, prob, cov)$pdf
  cumulative.distribution.function <- cumsum(mass.function)
  return(which(cumulative.distribution.function >= p)[1] - 1)
}

# Auxiliary function for calculating error probabilities for a given set of error rates
error_rate_calc <- function(pop.size, sample.size, possible.lbs, falsepos, falseneg, error.model)
{
  # rows are true number of positives in the sample
  # columns are observed number of positives in the sample
  true.to.observed.prob.matrix <- matrix(nrow=sample.size+1,ncol=sample.size+1)
  for(pos in 0:sample.size)
  {
    neg = sample.size-pos
    possibilities <- matrix(rep(0:pos,times=neg+1), nrow=neg+1, ncol=pos+1, byrow=T)
    addons <- matrix(rep(0:neg,times=pos+1), nrow=neg+1, ncol=pos+1, byrow=F)
    possarray <- possibilities+addons
    negtoposprobs <- error.model(0:neg, neg, falsepos)
    postonegprobs <- dbinom(0:pos, pos, 1-falseneg)
    probmatrix <- negtoposprobs %*% t(postonegprobs)
    # want to be able to add in more modeling options for how false positives materialize
    
    for(obs in 0:sample.size)
    {
      true.to.observed.prob.matrix[pos+1,obs+1] <- sum(probmatrix[possarray==obs])
    }
  }
  
  error.rate <- numeric(pop.size+1)
  for(true.pos in 0:pop.size)
  {
    true.probs <- dhyper(0:sample.size, true.pos, pop.size-true.pos, sample.size)
    obs.probs <- t(true.probs) %*% true.to.observed.prob.matrix
    error.rate[true.pos+1] <- sum(obs.probs[possible.lbs>true.pos])
  }
  
  return(error.rate)
}

# Auxiliary function for looping through sample sizes to find one that satisfies a given knowledge percentage
minimum_knowledge_sample_size <- function(pop, numerror, knowledgeperc, alpha)
{
  if(numerror >= pop)
  {
    return(Inf)
  }
  
  threshold <- pop * knowledgeperc
  outinfo <- Inf
  sample_size = max(1, numerror+1)
  
  while(outinfo == Inf & sample_size <= pop)
  {
    checkvals <- sample_size-numerror
    bounds <- olcb.hgps(checkvals, sample_size, pop, alpha)
    if(bounds >= threshold)
    {
      outinfo <- sample_size
    }
    sample_size <- sample_size + 1
  }
  
  return(outinfo)
}

# Auxiliary function for looping through population sizes to ensure monotonicity if requested
minimum_knowledge_sample_size_monotonic <- function(pop, numerror, knowledgeperc, alpha)
{
  # first check if the provided inputs are even possible
  ss.baseline <- minimum_knowledge_sample_size(pop, numerror, knowledgeperc, alpha)
  if(ss.baseline == Inf){return(ss.baseline)}
  outinfo <- ss.baseline
  # then make sure that there's not any higher sample sizes below this pop size
  search.minimum <- max(ss.baseline, pop-500)
  for(p in search.minimum:pop)
  {
    satisfied <- F
    while(!satisfied)
    {
      best.bound <- olcb.hgps(outinfo-numerror, outinfo, p, alpha)
      if(best.bound/p >= knowledgeperc){satisfied = T}
      else{outinfo = outinfo + 1}
    }
  }
  return(outinfo)
}

# Auxiliary function for calculating lower confidence bounds. Can be vectorized for one argument at a time.
olcb.hgps <- function(x,n,N,alpha)
{ 
  kk=1:length(x)
  for (i in kk)
  {
    if (x[i]<0.5)
    {
      kk[i]=0
    } 
    else
    {
      aa=0:N
      bb=aa+1
      bb[2:(N+1)]=phyper(x[i]-1,aa[2:(N+1)]-1,N-aa[2:(N+1)]+1,n)
      dd=cbind(aa,bb)
      dd=dd[which(dd[,2]>=1-alpha),]
      if (length(dd)==2)
      {
        kk[i]=dd[1]
      }
      else {kk[i]=max(dd[,1])
      }
    }
  }
  kk
}
